name: Miru & Kaku
source:
Two bird-like animals that are very childish and have an obsession with Christmas. They are always shown together and are never distinguished from one another in the game. 

[spoiler]They were created by Ryuuji Kawara and were set to be killed as a failed experiment, but Ryuuji took them in and raised them as his own. They consider him their father.[/spoiler]
